title: 2026 UK CBAM importer and liable-person QA controls

sources.title: Check if you’re classed as the importer for Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)
Check if you’ll need to register for Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)

facts.source_fact: CBAM liability is assigned to the importer, described by HMRC as the liable person.
facts.expected_handling: Bind liability to the importer identity, not a generic supply-chain party.

facts.source_fact: The importer can be established in the UK or outside the UK.
facts.expected_handling: Do not use establishment country alone to exclude liability.

facts.source_fact: Where customs duties are payable, the importer is the individual or organisation named on the import declaration.
facts.expected_handling: Use the declaration identity when duties are payable.

facts.source_fact: Where no customs duties are payable, the importer is the individual or organisation importing the goods.
facts.expected_handling: Do not require a duty-paying declaration to identify the liable person.

facts.source_fact: A person completing an import declaration on another party’s behalf does not by itself become the importer.
HMRC examples of organisations include small or medium-sized enterprises and large businesses.
facts.expected_handling: Do not restrict liable organisations by business size.

facts.source_fact: A government department or other public authority carrying out business for commercial purposes can be an organisation for this test.
A charity can be an organisation for the importer test.
HMRC lists tax agents, employees, freight forwarders, hauliers, customs brokers, express operators and fast parcel operators as parties that may act on an importer’s behalf.
facts.expected_handling: Do not confuse a representative role with liable-person status.

facts.source_fact: Once importer status is established, HMRC directs the importer to check which goods do not contribute to the registration threshold.
facts.expected_handling: Run threshold-exclusion logic after importer classification.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve organisation examples without treating them as exhaustive.
Importer test precedes threshold registration logic.
Use the 16 July 2026 HMRC guidance state.
Do not infer facility or parcel emissions from importer status.
Flag ambiguous principal, declaration or duty status.
